e.title: **宁可报错，也不悄悄把两种粒度混在一起**：R 包 **inedemogR**（CRAN 0.1.0）——**实时取西班牙国家统计局「人口现象」域的人口／出生／死亡数据**，**并明确声明每个指标只在其来源表真正发布的那个地理层级可用**（**跨层级同调即报错**）；**⭐ 它还逐字提醒某个函数名会误导人**（**`crude_birth_rate()` 算的是粗出生率，不是总和生育率**）；**⭐⭐ 登记处把它拆成两个仓库**：**站点仓库指向包仓库**，**而 r-universe 的命名空间与 GitHub 仓库名并不一致**
e.title_en: Refusing loudly rather than quietly mixing two granularities: the R package inedemogR, at CRAN version 0.1.0, retrieves live population, birth and death data from the Spanish national statistics institute demographic domain while stating that each indicator is available only at the geographic level its source table actually publishes, raising an error when indicators from different levels are requested together, and going out of its way to warn that one of its own function names misleads, since the crude birth rate function does not compute a total fertility rate; the registries also split it across two repositories, with a site repository pointing at the package repository and a registry namespace that does not match the GitHub repository name.
e.title_hk: **寧可報錯，也不悄悄把兩種粒度混在一起**：R 套件 **inedemogR**（CRAN 0.1.0）——**即時取西班牙國家統計局「人口現象」域的人口／出生／死亡資料**，**並明確聲明每個指標只在其來源表真正發布的那個地理層級可用**（**跨層級同調即報錯**）；**⭐ 它還逐字提醒某個函數名會誤導人**（**`crude_birth_rate()` 算的是粗出生率，不是總和生育率**）；**⭐⭐ 登記處把它拆成兩個倉庫**：**站點倉庫指向套件倉庫**，**而 r-universe 的命名空間與 GitHub 倉庫名並不一致**
e.summary: **inedemogR**（仓库 `jrcarob/inedemogR`，**包源码在** `jrcarob/inedemogR_package`）**是一个把西班牙国家统计局（INE）「人口现象」域的数据取成整齐数据框的 R 包**：**人口、出生、死亡**，**经官方** `ineapir` **接口实时获取**，**可选接** `mapSpain` **与** `sf` **做空间整合**；**CRAN 版本 0.1.0**，**作者** J. R. Caro-Barrera。**本条目属于本轮主题**「登记与出处」**，**它在两端都给了样本**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 出处**——**每个指标都声明自己的地理层级**（**逐字**「**Indicators are only available at the geographic level their source INE table is actually published at**」，**并点名** `population_total` **是市级、**`births_total`／`deaths_total` **是省级**），**且**「**Requesting indicators that span different levels in one call raises an error rather than silently mixing granularities**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 反误读**——**逐字**「**Note `crude_birth_rate()` computes a *crude* birth rate (births/population), not a total fertility rate.**」**，**并给出该用哪三个函数才能得到真正的 TFR**；**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 登记**——**它被拆成两个 GitHub 仓库**（**站点** `jrcarob/inedemogR`：**创建与推送都在 2026-09-09**；**包** `jrcarob/inedemogR_package`：**推送 2026-09-07**），**站点 README 逐字指路**「**Package source and issues: https://github.com/jrcarob/inedemogR_package.**」**；**而** r-universe **的命名空间写作** `jrcarob/inedemogR`、**GitHub 包仓库名却是** `inedemogR_package`**。**⭐⭐ ④ 它还有一条省级、按年龄与性别分列的死亡率流水线**（**逐字**「**a province-level, age/sex-disaggregated SHMD mortality pipeline**」），**并逐字写出本版**没有**什么**（**逐字**「**Migration indicators are not included in this release.**」**）。**⚠️ 本次未安装 R、未运行、未调用过 INE 接口**。

R. Caro-Barrera。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「登記與出處」**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 出處**——**每個指標都聲明自己的地理層級**（**逐字**「**Indicators are only available at the geographic level their source INE table is actually published at**」），**且**「**raises an error rather than silently mixing granularities**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 反誤讀**——**逐字**「**Note `crude_birth_rate()` computes a *crude* birth rate (births/population), not a total fertility rate.**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 登記**——**它被拆成兩個 GitHub 倉庫**（**站點** `jrcarob/inedemogR`：**建立與推送都在 2026-09-09**；**套件** `jrcarob/inedemogR_package`：**推送 2026-09-07**），**站點 README 逐字指路**「**Package source and issues: https://github.com/jrcarob/inedemogR_package.**」**。**⭐⭐ ④ 它還有一條省級、按年齡與性別分列的死亡率流水線**，**並逐字寫出本版**沒有**什麼**（**逐字**「**Migration indicators are not included in this release.**」**）。**⚠️ 本次未安裝 R、未運行、未呼叫過 INE 介面**。
e.summary_en: **inedemogR**, whose repository is `jrcarob/inedemogR` while the package source sits in `jrcarob/inedemogR_package`, **is an R package that retrieves data from the Spanish national statistics institute demographic domain as tidy data frames**: population, births and deaths, fetched live through the official `ineapir` interface, with optional spatial integration through `mapSpain` and `sf`; **CRAN version 0.1.0**, by J. R. Caro-Barrera. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registration and provenance, and the package provides a sample at both ends**: each indicator declares its own geographic level, verbatim, that indicators are only available at the geographic level their source table is actually published at, naming municipality-level and province-level indicators explicitly, and that requesting indicators spanning different levels in one call raises an error rather than silently mixing granularities; **it also warns verbatim that one of its own function names misleads**, noting that the crude birth rate function computes a crude rate rather than a total fertility rate and naming the three functions that give a true total fertility rate instead; **and it is split across two GitHub repositories**, a site repository created and pushed on 2026-09-09 and a package repository pushed on 2026-09-07, where the site README points at the package repository in one verbatim line, while the registry namespace and the GitHub repository name do not match. **It also carries a province-level, age and sex disaggregated mortality pipeline**, and states verbatim what this release does not include. **R was not installed this round, nothing was run and the national statistics interface was never called.**
e.body:
**inedemogR**（**站点仓库** `jrcarob/inedemogR`；**包源码仓库** `jrcarob/inedemogR_package`）**是一个把西班牙国家统计局（INE）「人口现象」（`fenómenos demográficos`）域的数据取成整齐数据框的 R 包**，**逐字自述为**「**provides tidy access to demographic data from the Spanish National Statistics Institute (INE), specifically its "fenómenos demográficos" domain: population, births, and deaths**」**，**数据经官方** `ineapir` **接口**（**仓库** `es-ine/ineapir`）**实时获取**，**并可选接** `mapSpain` **与** `sf` **做空间整合**。**本次实测**：**CRAN 包版本 0.1.0**，**作者** `J. R. Caro-Barrera`（**引用块逐字给出** `2026` **与版本** `0.1.0`**）**；**两个 GitHub 仓库**——**站点仓库 `jrcarob/inedemogR` 创建与推送都在 2026-09-09**、**README 实测 807 字节**；**包仓库 `jrcarob/inedemogR_package` 推送日期 2026-09-07**、**README 实测 5,500 字节**；**r-universe 条目** `jrcarob/inedemogR`**（`RemoteSha` 为** `31c030eacf`**，`_registered` 为** `true`**，最近一个月下载 234，来源逐字指向** `cranlogs.r-pkg.org`**）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「**登记与出处：让别人查得到，也让每个数回得去**」**。

**可核实信息（均两个仓库的 README、r-universe 与 CRAN 记录实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 每个指标都声明自己的地理层级，跨层级同调直接报错**——**包 README 逐字**：**「**Indicators are only available at the geographic level their source INE table is actually published at: `population_total` is municipality-level, `births_total`/`deaths_total` are province-level. Requesting indicators that span different levels in one call raises an error rather than silently mixing granularities — see `list_ine_indicators()`.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**它把「数据本身只发布到某一层」当成**数据的属性**，**而不是**使用者的问题**——**⭐ 即**它**不替你把市级数据摊到省级**（**也不反过来**），**而是在你写出跨层调用时报错**；**⭐ 并且它给出一个**先查再用**的入口** `list_ine_indicators()`**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它逐字提醒某个函数名会误导人**——**逐字**：**「**Note `crude_birth_rate()` computes a *crude* birth rate (births/population), not a total fertility rate. For a true TFR, use `get_ine_births_by_age()` (age-of-mother birth counts) with `age_specific_fertility_rate()`/`total_fertility_rate()`:**」**，**随后给出可复制的三行代码**。**⭐ 即**它**没有把「c-r-u-d-e」留在函数名里让你自己发现**，**而是直接写出**「**这个函数不是你以为的那个东西**」**，**并指出正确路径**——**这也是本站 [[human-mortality-db]]、[[demography]] 一类条目反复出现的同一类问题：**指标定义差一点，结论差很远**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 登记处把它拆开了，而且拆得不一致**——**站点仓库 README 只有 807 字节**，**内容除了一句自述与安装方式外，逐字给出**：**「**Package source and issues: https://github.com/jrcarob/inedemogR_package.**」**，**且其徽章指向的是**包仓库**里的工作流**（**逐字** `jrcarob/inedemogR_package/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml`**）**——**⭐ 即**站点仓库**自己不带构建状态**，**而是把徽章接到**另一个仓库**的 CI 上**。**⭐ 而** r-universe **的命名空间写作** `jrcarob/inedemogR`**，**GitHub 上的包仓库却叫** `inedemogR_package`**——**即**同一个包在**站点仓库名**、**包仓库名**、**登记处命名空间**三处**写法并不统一**；**本词条如实记录这一处**，**不评价其好坏**。**⭐⭐ ④ 它明确分成两套并行系统，并逐字写出各覆盖什么**——**包 README 的 Status 一节逐字**：**System A** 为 `get_ine_demog()`、`get_ine_geo()`、`list_ine_indicators()`、`plot_ine_map()`，**逐字说明它实现的是**「**live retrieval and mapping of municipality/province-level total counts**」；**System B** 为 `get_ine_births()`／`get_ine_deaths()`／`get_ine_population()`、`compute_exposure()`、`compute_death_rates()`、`build_life_tables()`、`download_ine_data()`，**逐字说明它实现的是**「**a province-level, age/sex-disaggregated SHMD mortality pipeline**」，**其上再叠加汇总指标**（`age_dependency_ratio()`、`aging_index()`、`sex_ratio()`、`crude_birth_rate()`、`life_expectancy_summary()`**）与图表**（`plot_population_pyramid()`、`plot_demog_trend()`、`map_life_expectancy()`**）**；**并逐字说明两套的定位是**「**two deliberately parallel, complementary workflows — neither subsumes the other, since they operate at different geographic and demographic granularities**」。**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**`SHMD` 这个缩写在该 README 里没有展开**（**本次未读源码，故不猜**）。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 它逐字写出本版**没有**什么**——**逐字**：**「**Migration indicators are not included in this release.**」**与**「**Cleaning/harmonization helpers and projections are planned.**」**。**⭐ 即**「**已有**」与「**没有**」**写在同一节里**，**而不是留给使用者去发现**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 一条完整的省级寿命流水线可被读出来**——**README 逐字注释**：**「**Life expectancy: full pipeline through life tables, then map it, bridging this province-level analysis back onto `get_ine_geo()’s spatial layer**」**，**接着是七行可复制代码**（`get_ine_population()` → `get_ine_deaths()` → `compute_exposure()` → `compute_death_rates()` → `build_life_tables()` → `life_expectancy_summary()` → `map_life_expectancy()`**）**——**⭐ 即**从取数到「把寿命画到地图上」**是一条明写的链**（**与本词条项目第 350 轮的「源与生成物」主题同形**）。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 它带一个可核对的引用块**——**逐字**：**「**If you use `inedemogR` in your work, please cite it. Run `citation("inedemogR")` for the current entry**」**，**并给出** BibTeX `@Manual` **条目**（**含标题、作者、年份、版本与 CRAN 包页链接**）。**⭐ 即**「**别人要引用你时该写什么**」**也被当成包的一部分**——**这与 [[colombian-pension-observatory]] 一类「把数据与出处一起交付」的条目取向一致**。**⭐ ⑧ 与既有条目的关系**：**本站 [[human-mortality-db]]、[[demography]]、[[mortcast]] 覆盖人口与死亡率的国际数据与方法**，**本条补上的是**一个国家统计机构官方接口的整齐化封装**（**并附一条建表到地图的链**）；**其自述的** `mapSpain` **与** `sf` **空间整合**，**与 [[spatialrisk]] 一类空间风险条目可并读但不同用途**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[human-mortality-db]]、[[demography]]、[[mortcast]] 应当并读**——**它给的是「国家统计机构的数据怎么被取成可直接建模的形状」的一个具体样本**，**而它最值得学的两点与精算无关而与数据纪律有关**：**① 数据只发布到某一层，就不要跨层混用；② 一个函数名可能误导人，那就把「它不是什么」写出来**.

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有安装 R、没有安装该包、没有调用过 INE 接口、没有取回任何一行数据**，**故不主张**任何函数按所述工作、不主张取回的数据正确、也不主张那条寿命流水线的数值结果。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何 R 源码**——**本次只读了两个仓库的 README、r-universe 条目与 CRAN 记录**，**故不主张**指标的完整清单、`SHMD` 的含义、`build_life_tables()` 的建表方法（**是周期性生命表还是队列生命表**）、`crude_birth_rate()` 的分母口径、以及空间整合的实际实现。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实 INE 接口的稳定性与配额**，**未核实** `ineapir` **的状态与它是否仍在维护**（**本次只看到被引用**）。**④ ⚠️ 未核实** CRAN 版本 0.1.0 **与该包是否为首次发布**、**未查其 CRAN check 结果**、**未读其 vignette**（**README 逐字提到** `vignette("inedemogR-tutorial")` **覆盖每个函数与死亡率流水线的数学**，**本次未打开**）。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实「两套系统」的边界是否真如所述**（**例如 System A 是否真的只做总量、不涉年龄结构**）——**本词条只转述其自述**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实作者背景与该项目是否与任何机构有关**（**README 与引用块只给出个人姓名**）；**r-universe 上 234 的月下载数不构成质量证据**。**⑦ ⚠️ 站点仓库创建与推送都在 2026-09-09、包仓库推送 2026-09-07，两者都在解冻窗口之内**，**故本条不需要窗口例外**；**⭐ 但本词条如实指出**：**一个包同时拥有站点仓库与包仓库、且两者命名与登记处命名空间不一致**这一形态**，此前池内没有对应物**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。 **⑨ ⚠️ 引号约定**：**本条目逐字引用时，把原文里的 ASCII 撇号（如 `get_ine_geo()` 后面的所有格）写作 ’，以维持本词条不出现 ASCII 单引号的约定（引文内容未改）**。

## 同类工具
[[mapsnap-georeferencer]]、[[naphia]]、[[npi]]、[[aviareto]]、[[ecb-data]]
e.body_hk:
**inedemogR**（**站點倉庫** `jrcarob/inedemogR`；**套件原始碼倉庫** `jrcarob/inedemogR_package`）**是一個把西班牙國家統計局（INE）「人口現象」（`fenómenos demográficos`）域的資料取成整齊資料框的 R 套件**，**資料經官方** `ineapir` **介面**（**倉庫** `es-ine/ineapir`）**即時取得**，**並可選接** `mapSpain` **與** `sf` **做空間整合**。**本次實測**：**CRAN 套件版本 0.1.0**，**作者** `J. R. Caro-Barrera`；**兩個 GitHub 倉庫**——**站點倉庫建立與推送都在 2026-09-09**、**README 807 位元組**；**套件倉庫推送 2026-09-07**、**README 5,500 位元組**；**r-universe 條目的** `RemoteSha` **為** `31c030eacf`、`_registered` **為** `true`、**最近一個月下載 234**。本條目屬於本輪主題**「登記與出處」**。

**可核實資訊（均兩個倉庫的 README、r-universe 與 CRAN 記錄實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 每個指標都聲明自己的地理層級，跨層級同調直接報錯**——**逐字**：**「**Indicators are only available at the geographic level their source INE table is actually published at: `population_total` is municipality-level, `births_total`/`deaths_total` are province-level. Requesting indicators that span different levels in one call raises an error rather than silently mixing granularities — see `list_ine_indicators()`.**」**。**⭐ 即**它**不替你把市級資料攤到省級**，**而是在你寫出跨層呼叫時報錯**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它逐字提醒某個函數名會誤導人**——**逐字**：**「**Note `crude_birth_rate()` computes a *crude* birth rate (births/population), not a total fertility rate. For a true TFR, use `get_ine_births_by_age()` (age-of-mother birth counts) with `age_specific_fertility_rate()`/`total_fertility_rate()`:**」**，**隨後給出可複製的三行程式碼**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 登記處把它拆開了，而且拆得不一致**——**站點 README 只有 807 位元組**，**逐字給出**：**「**Package source and issues: https://github.com/jrcarob/inedemogR_package.**」**，**且其徽章指向**套件倉庫**裡的工作流**；**⭐ 而** r-universe **的命名空間寫作** `jrcarob/inedemogR`**，**GitHub 上的套件倉庫卻叫** `inedemogR_package`**。**⭐⭐ ④ 它明確分成兩套並行系統，並逐字寫出各覆蓋什麼**——**System A**（`get_ine_demog()`、`get_ine_geo()`、`list_ine_indicators()`、`plot_ine_map()`）**逐字為**「**live retrieval and mapping of municipality/province-level total counts**」；**System B**（`get_ine_births()`／`get_ine_deaths()`／`get_ine_population()`、`compute_exposure()`、`compute_death_rates()`、`build_life_tables()`、`download_ine_data()`）**逐字為**「**a province-level, age/sex-disaggregated SHMD mortality pipeline**」；**並逐字說明兩套的定位是**「**two deliberately parallel, complementary workflows — neither subsumes the other, since they operate at different geographic and demographic granularities**」。**⚠️** `SHMD` **這個縮寫在 README 裡沒有展開**（**不猜**）。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 它逐字寫出本版**沒有**什麼**——**逐字**：**「**Migration indicators are not included in this release.**」**與**「**Cleaning/harmonization helpers and projections are planned.**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 一條完整的省級壽命流水線可被讀出來**——**逐字註解**：**「**Life expectancy: full pipeline through life tables, then map it, bridging this province-level analysis back onto `get_ine_geo()’s spatial layer**」**，**接著是七行可複製程式碼**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 它帶一個可核對的引用塊**——**逐字**：**「**If you use `inedemogR` in your work, please cite it. Run `citation("inedemogR")` for the current entry**」**，**並給出** BibTeX `@Manual` **條目**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[human-mortality-db]]、[[demography]]、[[mortcast]] 應當並讀**——**它最值得學的兩點與精算無關而與資料紀律有關**：**① 資料只發布到某一層，就不要跨層混用；② 一個函數名可能誤導人，那就把「它不是什麼」寫出來**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有安裝 R、沒有安裝該套件、沒有呼叫過 INE 介面、沒有取回任何一行資料**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀任何 R 原始碼**——**本次只讀了兩個倉庫的 README、r-universe 條目與 CRAN 記錄**，**故不主張**指標完整清單、`SHMD` 的含義、`build_life_tables()` 的建表方法、`crude_birth_rate()` 的分母口徑與空間整合實作。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實 INE 介面的穩定性與配額**，**未核實** `ineapir` **是否仍在維護**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實** CRAN 版本 0.1.0 **是否為首次發布**、**未查 CRAN check 結果**、**未讀** `vignette("inedemogR-tutorial")`**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實「兩套系統」的邊界是否真如所述**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實作者背景**；**月下載數不構成品質證據**。**⑦ ⚠️ 站點倉庫建立與推送都在 2026-09-09、套件倉庫推送 2026-09-07，兩者都在解凍窗口之內**，**故本條不需要窗口例外**；**⭐ 但一個包同時擁有站點倉庫與套件倉庫、且命名與登記處命名空間不一致**這一形態**此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。 **⑨ ⚠️ 引號約定**：**本條目逐字引用 README 程式碼註解時，把原文裡的 ASCII 撇號寫作 ’，以維持本詞條不出現 ASCII 單引號的約定（註解內容未改）**。

e.body_en:
**inedemogR**, whose site repository is `jrcarob/inedemogR` and whose package source lives in `jrcarob/inedemogR_package`, **is an R package that retrieves data from the Spanish national statistics institute demographic domain as tidy data frames** — population, births and deaths — **fetched live through the official `ineapir` interface**, with optional spatial integration through `mapSpain` and `sf`. **Measured this round**: **CRAN version 0.1.0**, by J. R. Caro-Barrera, with the citation block giving the year 2026 and the version explicitly; **two GitHub repositories**, the site repository created and pushed on 2026-09-09 with a README measuring 807 bytes, and the package repository pushed on 2026-09-07 with a README measuring 5,500 bytes; and an r-universe record pinning a commit SHA, reporting the package as registered and reporting 234 downloads in the last month. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registration and provenance: making something findable, and making every number traceable back.**

**Verified information, all measured from the two repositories, the r-universe record and the CRAN record**: **first, every indicator declares its own geographic level and mixing levels raises an error**: verbatim, indicators are only available at the geographic level their source table is actually published at, with population totals at municipality level and birth and death totals at province level, and requesting indicators that span different levels in one call raises an error rather than silently mixing granularities, pointing the reader at the indicator listing function. **The package treats the publication level as a property of the data rather than a problem for the user**: it does not spread municipal figures onto provinces, and it fails loudly when a call crosses levels, with a way to look before you leap. **Second, it warns verbatim that one of its own function names misleads**: it notes that the crude birth rate function computes a crude birth rate, births over population, and not a total fertility rate, then gives three copyable lines naming the age-of-mother birth counts and the two functions that produce a true total fertility rate. **Rather than leaving the word crude in a function name for the reader to notice, it states directly that this is not the thing you may think it is, and points at the right path.** **Third, the registries split it apart, and not consistently**: the site README is only 807 bytes and, besides a self-description and installation instructions, gives one verbatim line naming the package repository as the place where source and issues live, and its badge points at a workflow **inside the other repository**, so the site repository does not carry its own build status but wires a badge onto another repository continuous integration. Meanwhile the registry namespace is written without the suffix that the GitHub package repository carries, **so the same package is spelled differently across the site repository name, the package repository name and the registry namespace**, which this entry records without judging. **Fourth, it splits itself into two parallel systems and states what each covers**: System A implements live retrieval and mapping of municipality and province level total counts; System B implements a province-level, age and sex disaggregated mortality pipeline, with summary indicators and charts on top; and the two are described verbatim as deliberately parallel and complementary workflows, neither subsuming the other, because they operate at different geographic and demographic granularities. **The acronym used for the mortality data source is not expanded anywhere in the README, and this entry does not guess at it.** **Fifth, it states verbatim what this release does not include**: migration indicators are not included, and cleaning, harmonisation and projection helpers are planned. **Sixth, a complete province-level life expectancy pipeline can be read straight off the README**, from population and death retrieval through exposure, death rates and life tables to a life expectancy summary and a map, described verbatim as a full pipeline through life tables that bridges the province-level analysis back onto the spatial layer, in seven copyable lines. **Seventh, it carries a checkable citation block**, telling users to run the citation function for the current entry and giving a BibTeX entry with title, author, year, version and a CRAN package URL, **so what someone should write when they cite it is treated as part of the package**. **Eighth, relative to existing entries**: the pooled `[[human-mortality-db]]`, `[[demography]]` and `[[mortcast]]` entries cover international mortality data and methods, while this entry supplies a tidy wrapper over one national statistical office interface together with a chain from table building to a map.

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[human-mortality-db]], [[demography]] and [[mortcast]]**, because **it is a concrete sample of how a national statistical office dataset becomes a shape you can model directly**, and its two most transferable lessons are about data discipline rather than actuarial technique: **do not mix levels when the source only publishes at one, and if a function name can mislead, write down what it is not**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, R was not installed, the package was not installed, the statistics interface was never called and not one row of data was retrieved**, **so no function is claimed to work as described, no retrieved data is claimed correct and no numerical result of that life expectancy pipeline is claimed**. **Second, no R source was read**: only the two README files, the registry record and the CRAN record were read, **so nothing is claimed about the complete indicator list, the meaning of the acronym, whether the life table builder produces period or cohort tables, what denominator the crude birth rate uses, or how spatial integration is actually implemented — this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the stability and quota of the national statistics interface were not verified**, nor whether the API wrapper it depends on is still maintained, only that it is referenced. **Fourth, whether version 0.1.0 is a first release, the CRAN check results and the tutorial vignette that the README says covers every function and the mortality pipeline mathematics were all left unexamined**. **Fifth, whether the boundary between the two systems is really as described was not verified; this entry relays the package own statement.** **Sixth, the author background and any institutional affiliation were not checked**, the README and citation block giving only an individual name, and a monthly download count is not evidence of quality. **Seventh, both repositories were created and pushed on 2026-09-07 and 2026-09-09, inside the thaw window, so no window exception is needed here**; **however, the shape of one package owning both a site repository and a package repository under names that do not match the registry namespace had no counterpart in the pool**. **Eighth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11.** **Ninth, quotation convention: where quoted text contained an ASCII apostrophe, such as the possessive after a function name, this entry renders it as a curved apostrophe to keep the entry free of ASCII single quotes, with the quoted text otherwise unchanged.**
